verdict.rationale: Slack Workflow Builder supports event-triggered automations with triggers, conditional branching, and webhook triggers, plus Events API for programmatic event-driven actions and a Web API for enacting changes — together enabling rule-based automatic actions on events. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Workflow Builder's trigger-action rules in practice, and no evidence of AI-specific conditional rule authoring (e.g., natural-language rule definition) beyond generic workflow triggers.
